summary: Ten angles anchored in September 2026 competitor research: HubSpot UNBOUND agentic launches, Copy.ai's ASO concept, Jasper's ROI-confidence collapse data, and a Local GEO blind spot — filling angles left open by all 63 prior published and proposed titles.

competitors: Jasper's State of AI Marketing 2026 (1,400-marketer survey) dominates informational queries on AI marketing trends but addresses only enterprise concerns — governance frameworks, cross-functional blocker management, content-at-scale infrastructure — with no SMB-accessible action plan anywhere on their blog.

Copy.ai coined 'Agent Search Optimization' in a July 2026 post targeting GTM/sales teams, creating a first-mover vacuum for SMB marketers who want to be discovered by AI agents that autonomously shop, book, or plan on behalf of consumers.

HubSpot launched Campaign Agent, Content Agent, and Nurture Agent at UNBOUND on September 16, 2026; current SERP for related queries is filled only with agency partner press releases and HubSpot's own marketing copy — no independent SMB value-vs-cost verdict exists yet.

Writesonic is the most aggressive publisher on GEO tool roundups and ranks well for 'best GEO tools 2026', but produces no local-specific or B2B-vertical GEO content — leaving the 'why am I invisible in AI search?' diagnostic angle wide open for local and service-area businesses.
trends: Agentic AI adoption gap: only 7% of SMBs run production agents vs. 34% of enterprises (Upwork State of AI in SMBs 2026), creating a catch-up wave that will drive search demand for SMB-specific implementation guides through Q4 2026 and into 2027.

AI Overviews now appear in 47–64% of all Google queries (up from ~25% in 2024), driving a 58% average CTR decline — local brick-and-mortar businesses are disproportionately harmed and urgently searching for Local GEO fixes rather than tool roundups.

Agent Search Optimization (ASO) is emerging as the discoverability layer beyond GEO: AI agents that autonomously book, buy, and plan for consumers surface businesses based on structured inventory, pricing, and availability signals — not keyword match — requiring SMBs to rethink product data architecture.

Legal and compliance is now the #1 AI marketing adoption blocker per Jasper's 2026 survey, up 3.4× year-over-year — yet SMB-accessible legal guides covering FTC AI disclosure rules, AI-generated copyright exposure, and client-contract protection are virtually nonexistent in the content ecosystem.

HubSpot's UNBOUND September 2026 launches signal the mainstreaming of fully autonomous marketing execution (Campaign Agent auto-generates plans and assets; Nurture Agent personalizes each email send in real time), raising the bar for what SMBs expect from any marketing stack they pay for.
